description: Return the betslipdoctor.ai link (linkUrl) where the customer upgrades, the same page the website uses. plan is the plan they want (starter, pro or elite; default the next plan up), interval month or year (default month). The customer opens the link, signs in with this same account and confirms there; this tool never charges, never starts a payment and never changes the plan. A plan already billed by card gets the account page link, where Manage subscription switches it.
name: start_plan_upgrade
title: Upgrade my plan
